The powders were ball-milled in a planetary ball mill for 4 h in argon atmosphere with a rotation speed of 240 rpm. The ball-to-powder weight ratio was 8:1.

mechanisms.name: grain boundary cohesion enhancement by Zr

evidence.quote: While in WZ (Fig. 2b) and WZY alloy ( Fig. 2c), more transgranular ruptures were found, suggesting that the cohesion of GBs has been obviously improved.

Combining with microstructure analysis, the improved mechanical properties of the WZY alloy was suggested to be originated from the enhanced GBs cohesion by Zr micro-alloying and nano-sized yttria dispersion strengthening

mechanisms.name: pinning of dislocations and grain boundaries by ZrO2 particles

evidence.quote: In addition, the nano-sized zirconium oxide particles may also pin dislocations and GBs.

But the oxide particles at the GBs may also introduce stress concentrations and become the possible sites of crack initiation [9], which would reduce the ductility. This can be the reason why WZY has a lower ductility than WZ alloy.
The hardness was not obviously increased by adding small amount of Zr, but can be effectively improved by dispersing small amount of Y2O3 nano-particles.
The UTS of WZY alloy at 700 /C176C is 534 MPa, which is 81% and 58% higher than those of WZ alloy (295 MPa) and pure W (337 MPa), respectively.
